paragraphs.en: Returning to drawing, you first imagine making tiny colour notes on a few cards, then choose two to finish this week. The different format makes an entrance imaginable; a next step gives this particular experiment a stopping point. You can return to familiar practice or leave it aside if the cards do not interest you. More completed cards are not necessarily better, and this small arrangement supplies no evidence of artistic talent or suitability for an artistic occupation.

title.zh: 把点子与小范围行动连接
title.en: Connecting an idea to a bounded action

paragraphs.zh: 可以说“这个组合我想试一下，先做一个小样再决定是否继续”。你无需证明这是最好的点子，也不必把每个想法都变成任务。若活动涉及别人，可以先征求愿意参与的意见，不能因为小试验就省略同意。西北读法允许探索没有下文，也允许换回旧办法；推进是可选择的一步，不是用来证明自己有行动力的考试。
paragraphs.en: You could propose trying one sample of a combination before deciding whether to continue. You need neither prove it is the best idea nor turn every thought into a task. Where an activity involves others, ask whether they want to take part rather than treating a small trial as exempt from agreement. West-North allows an exploration to end without a larger project or return to a familiar approach. Movement is an optional step, not an examination in which you must demonstrate initiative.

title.zh: 与北西及西南的差别
title.en: Distinguishing North-West and West-South

paragraphs.en: North-West begins with movement as highest and alternatives as neighbour; West-North reverses that order. West-South also requires highest West but more South than North, while base West leaves those neighbours equal. East-North and North-East combine clarification and movement from different starting points; East-South and South-East do the same with participation. Other base and ordered guides keep their own conditions. These approaches can describe different stages of one activity without requiring a permanent allegiance to one compass point.

title.zh: 没有把点子落实也可能很合理
title.en: Leaving an idea unimplemented can be reasonable

paragraphs.zh: 有些想法只是聊天或休息的一部分，不需要完成；有些安排沿用旧方法更省心。你也可能喜欢试新形式，但因时间和材料不足暂不开始。较多北向不保证坚持，较少南向不能推出忽略别人；本版没有观察这些后续行为，也没有收集他人评价。西北不能预测创业、项目成效、职业收入或你是否比别人更有创造力。
paragraphs.en: Some ideas belong to conversation or rest and need no completion. Familiar methods may also make an arrangement easier. You might like another format but lack time or materials to begin. More North guarantees no persistence, and fewer South choices establish no disregard for others; the edition observes neither later conduct nor other people’s evaluations. West-North cannot predict entrepreneurship, project outcomes, occupational income or whether you are more creative than someone else. Deliberately leaving an idea unused can itself fit the circumstances.

description.en: Explore the West-South compass result: alternatives first with participation, an optional book-exchange example and full tie rules.

title.zh: 新办法需要被实际参与者看见
title.en: An alternative needs actual participants’ responses

paragraphs.zh: 西南从尝试不同方式的选项起步，再由南北比较带出参与邻向。你可能先想到一种新的书籍交换形式，再问谁愿意参加、怎样加入更方便。这里没有把新鲜感自动等同好办法，也没有把顾及参与当作你总能理解别人。一个方案是否值得共同使用，需要由实际条件和参与者回应来决定，而不是由方向标签替他们作主。
paragraphs.en: West-South starts with another way of approaching an activity and adds participation through the North-South comparison. You might imagine a different book-exchange format before asking who would enjoy taking part and what would make joining easier. Novelty is not automatically a good method, and attention to participation establishes no universal understanding of others. Whether a proposal merits shared use depends on practical conditions and people’s responses. A direction cannot decide on their behalf or turn your invitation into their agreement.

title.zh: 西南的邻向比较有明确范围
title.en: The neighbour comparison has a defined scope

paragraphs.zh: 西向须达到全局最高，且南向严格多于北向，才显示西南；东向可以仍高于南向，邻向并非总次数第二。南向也达到最高时，南西完整说明同时呈现；若南北同分，只显示基础西向并说明未分出邻向。所有其他最高也保留对应读法，不用一个最先列出的标签覆盖它们。一次作答不能判断这些偏好是否会长期保持。
paragraphs.en: West must reach the global maximum and South strictly exceed North. East can still exceed South, so the neighbour is not necessarily the overall runner-up. If South also shares the maximum, its full South-West guide appears. Equal South and North produce base West with no distinguished neighbour. Other highest directions retain their applicable guides rather than being replaced by the first label listed. One attempt cannot establish how long these preferences will persist or whether a small difference will survive a changed setting.

title.zh: 交换书籍的玩法怎样被共同修改
title.en: How a book-exchange idea can be revised together

paragraphs.zh: 社区准备交换闲置书，你先提议做一轮“只看一句介绍”的挑选，再请参与者说是否愿意，也保留直接看书名的普通交换。有人不喜欢盲选，就不必参加这一轮；没有参加也不表示不合群。你可以根据回应把新环节缩短或取消。例子把尝试当作共同讨论的提议，而不是为了维护创意就要求别人配合。
paragraphs.en: For a community book exchange, you suggest a round where people choose from one-sentence descriptions, then ask whether they want it and keep an ordinary title-visible exchange available. Someone who dislikes the format need not join that round, and declining establishes no lack of sociability. Responses may lead you to shorten or cancel it. The experiment remains a shared proposal rather than something others must support to protect your idea or prove that they are cooperative.

title.zh: 让修改点子不伤及人的选择
title.en: Keeping revision separate from judging a person

paragraphs.zh: 可以说“我想到这个小玩法，愿意的人可以试，不合适就按原方式；如果有哪里不方便，我们可以直接改”。你不把点子被拒绝当作对自己的否定，也不把他人不同意当作缺少开放性。你同样可以拒绝承担活动组织，只贡献一个想法。西南读法没有规定你要让每个人满意，真实的选择空间比参与形式看起来热闹更重要。
paragraphs.en: You could offer the format to willing people, keep the familiar version available and invite changes wherever it is inconvenient. Rejection of an idea need not become rejection of you, and disagreement need not become a judgment of someone’s openness. You can also contribute an idea while declining to organise the activity. West-South requires no universal satisfaction. Actual room to choose matters more than making participation look lively, and another format should remain open to being left unused.

title.zh: 西南与南西不是交换名字
title.en: West-South and South-West are not renamed copies

paragraphs.en: South-West begins with participation needs and adds an alternative; West-South begins with another approach and then reads participation as its neighbour. West-North requires more North than South under highest West, while base West leaves them equal. South-East and East-South start with participation or sequence; North-West and West-North with movement or alternatives. Other ordered and base guides keep their own conditions. An absent guide does not establish an absent approach, and the order of real behaviour need not remain fixed.

title.zh: 不提供新形式也可以尊重参与
title.en: Participation can be respected without another format

paragraphs.zh: 如果大家已经喜欢现有活动，保留它可能比增加新环节更合适。你也可以在陌生小组先听安排，不立即提点子；这不反驳你的其他选择。较多南向不证明共情水平，较少北向不表示缺乏推进能力；题目没有评这些能力。西南不能判断关系是否健康、谁更受欢迎或你适合什么工作，也没有要求你为了照顾参与而一直陪伴。
paragraphs.en: If people already enjoy the activity, keeping it can fit better than adding another round. You may listen first in an unfamiliar group rather than immediately offering ideas, without contradicting your other choices. More South proves no empathy level, and fewer North choices establish no lack of initiative; those abilities are not assessed. West-South cannot judge relationship health, popularity or occupational fit and creates no obligation to provide ongoing company for the sake of participation.

title.zh: 回看一个提议是否真的可拒绝
title.en: Reviewing whether a proposal could actually be declined

paragraphs.zh: 若愿意，回想一次你提出的小变化：有没有保留原办法，参与者能否说不，回应怎样改变了提议？再想一个你没有提出新点子却相处顺畅的例子。无需评价任何人的开放程度或向网站提交私人故事。观察是可选的，结果正文已经完整免费；继续其他测评需要独立作答，也可以在这里结束。
paragraphs.en: If useful, recall a small change you proposed: whether the familiar method remained available, whether people could decline and how responses changed the proposal. Compare a comfortable interaction where you offered no new idea. There is no need to rate anyone’s openness or submit a private story. The observation is optional and the result text is already complete and free. Continuing with another assessment requires separate answers, and you can end the reflection here.

answer.en: All thirty-six questions, four raw tallies and twelve full nine-section guides are free without signup, email or another test. Answers are counted in the browser without uploading or entering URLs or analytics; no private history, ethnicity or Arab cultural identity is requested. Opted-in drafts remain in this tab for twenty-four hours and clear on completion, retake or exit-and-clear. Optional sharing includes public reading names and links without answers, counts or personal ranks. Other frameworks require separate complete answers rather than direction conversion. You can read directly or stop here.
